command_or_source: App commit fd3376c85a70a8b46e43318876703863a774409f: bash scripts/test.sh with MockShortcutPermissions, MockMultitouchMonitor, MockTrackpadShortcutPoster and MockAlerts.
result_summary: Injected multitouch start failure and accessibility denial for action-only bindings keep the action target persisted undegraded, leave listening stopped or untrusted, and raise 触控板监听未启动 and 触控板快捷键需要辅助功能权限. Pre-existing shortcut-binding fault paths remain intact.
limitations: A real mid-session TCC revocation was not induced on the development machine.
